_description: Synthetic check-chain rows for offline review and tests. Every name and value is invented for UI and logic testing; none is a real catalog entry or a dated live query. Gaia DR3 rows come from the existing nearby_*.json fixtures. A query selects the scenario with the nearest anchor; rows then match by their own coordinates.

scenarios.name: high_proper_motion
scenarios._note: Anchor at the Barnard's Star preset. Rows share one fast proper motion at different reference epochs, so they only match after propagation to a recent epoch. The 2MASS row has no proper motion and stays ~85 arcsec away.

scenarios.name: cold_brown_dwarf
scenarios._note: Anchor at the WISE 0855 preset. Listed by the cold-object catalogs.

scenarios.name: empty_field
scenarios._note: Anchor at the sparse-field Gaia fixture. No catalog lists anything here.

scenarios.name: known_asteroid
scenarios._note: Only the solar-system step lists an object, so the point is explained only when a dated frame supplies the observation time.
